name: Xie Daoyun
shortBio: Eastern Jin Chinese philosopher, poet, and Neo-Daoist Xuanxue dialectician celebrated for mastering pure conversation (qingtan) metaphysics and demonstrating women’s equal philosophical acuity in classical China.
centralQuestion: How do poetic metaphor and dialectical pure conversation (qingtan) disclose the spontaneous patterns of Daoist naturalness (ziran)?

keyWorks.title: Qingtan Dialectics & Climbing the Mountain (Recorded in Shishuo Xinyu)
keyWorks.description: Surviving Xuanxue philosophical debates and nature poetry exemplifying Wei-Jin Neo-Daoist aesthetic and metaphysical wit.
